jumping_jack.name: Jumping Jack
jumping_jack.description: Full-body cardio exercise. Jump the feet out while sweeping the arms overhead, then return.
jumping_jack.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Arms not overhead
faults.cue: Reach all the way up — bring your hands above your head
faults.cue_side: Your {side} arm isn't reaching overhead — swing it all the way up

faults.label: Feet too narrow
faults.cue: Jump your feet wider — land just past shoulder width

faults.label: Bent arms
faults.cue: Keep your arms long — straighten through the elbows
faults.cue_side: Straighten your {side} arm through the whole swing

correction_tips: Reach your arms fully overhead on every rep
Keep your arms long, not bent
Land softly on the balls of your feet
jumping_jack.voice_intro: Let's do jumping jacks! Reach all the way overhead and land softly.

squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
squat.description: Sit the hips back and down until the thighs are about parallel, then drive back up.
squat.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Not deep enough
faults.cue: Sink a little deeper — aim for thighs parallel to the floor

faults.label: Chest dropping
faults.cue: Lift your chest — keep your torso tall as you sit back

correction_tips: Push your hips back like sitting into a chair
Keep your chest up and back flat
Aim for thighs parallel to the floor
squat.voice_intro: Time for squats. Sit back, chest up, and drive through your heels.

push_up.name: Push-Up
push_up.description: Lower your chest toward the floor with a rigid plank body, then press back up.
push_up.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, whole body visible

setup.cue: Get into a high plank — hands under your shoulders, body in one line

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.cue: Lift your hips — squeeze your glutes and brace your core

faults.label: Hips too high
faults.cue: Lower your hips into one straight line from head to heels

faults.label: Shallow rep
faults.cue: Lower your chest further — bend your elbows to about 90°

correction_tips: Squeeze your glutes and brace your core
Lower until your elbows reach about 90°
Keep elbows at roughly 45° from your body
push_up.voice_intro: Push-ups next. Brace your core and keep a straight line from head to heels.

lunge.name: Forward Lunge
lunge.description: Step forward and lower until both knees reach about 90°, then push back to standing.
lunge.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Not deep enough
faults.cue: Drop lower — let both knees bend to about 90°

faults.label: Leaning forward
faults.cue: Stay tall — keep your chest up and torso upright

correction_tips: Take a long enough step forward
Lower straight down, both knees near 90°
Push back through your front heel
lunge.voice_intro: Let's lunge. Long step, drop straight down, and stay tall.

bicep_curl.name: Bicep Curl
bicep_curl.description: Curl the hands toward the shoulders with the elbows pinned to your sides.
bicep_curl.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, upper body and hips in frame

faults.label: Elbow drifting forward
faults.cue: Pin your elbow to your side — only your forearm should move

faults.label: Partial curl
faults.cue: Curl all the way up and squeeze at the top

faults.label: Swinging
faults.cue: Stand tall and still — no swinging from the hips

correction_tips: Pin your elbows to your ribs
Squeeze at the top of every curl
Lower slowly, don't drop the weight
bicep_curl.voice_intro: Bicep curls. Elbows pinned, full squeeze at the top.

shoulder_press.name: Shoulder Press
shoulder_press.description: Press the hands from shoulder height to straight overhead, then lower with control.
shoulder_press.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, upper body and hips in frame

faults.label: No lockout
faults.cue: Press all the way up — fully straighten your arms overhead

faults.label: Pressing forward
faults.cue: Press straight up — finish with your arms by your ears

faults.label: Leaning back
faults.cue: Brace your core and keep your ribs down — don't lean back

correction_tips: Press straight up, finishing with arms by your ears
Keep your ribs down and core tight
Lower to shoulder height each rep
shoulder_press.voice_intro: Shoulder press. Brace your core and press straight overhead.

high_knees.name: High Knees
high_knees.description: Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height with a tall torso.
high_knees.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Knees too low
faults.cue: Drive your knees higher — up to hip height

faults.label: Leaning to one side
faults.cue: Stay tall and centred over your hips

correction_tips: Drive each knee up to hip height
Land softly on the balls of your feet
high_knees.voice_intro: High knees! Drive those knees up to hip height and stay tall.

glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
glute_bridge.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, drive your hips up until your body forms a line from shoulders to knees.
glute_bridge.camera_setup: Set the camera at floor level, side-on, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor

faults.label: Hips not fully up
faults.cue: Squeeze your glutes and push your hips all the way up

faults.label: Feet too far away
faults.cue: Walk your feet closer — knees at about 90° at the top

faults.label: Feet too close
faults.cue: Move your feet a little further from your hips

correction_tips: Squeeze your glutes at the top
glute_bridge.voice_intro: Glute bridges. Drive through your heels and squeeze at the top.

plank.name: Plank
plank.description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms or hands.
plank.camera_setup: Set the camera at floor level, side-on, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Get into a plank — elbows or hands under your shoulders, body in one line

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.cue: Lift your hips — squeeze your glutes and brace your core

faults.label: Hips too high
faults.cue: Lower your hips into one straight line from head to heels

correction_tips: Brace your core like you're about to be poked
plank.voice_intro: Plank hold. Long line from head to heels, and breathe.

wall_sit.name: Wall Sit
wall_sit.description: Back flat against a wall, slide down until your knees are at 90° and hold.
wall_sit.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

setup.cue: Slide down the wall until your knees are bent

faults.label: Not low enough
faults.cue: Slide a little lower — thighs parallel to the floor

faults.label: Too low
faults.cue: Come up slightly — knees at about 90°

faults.label: Back off the wall
faults.cue: Press your back flat against the wall

wall_sit.voice_intro: Wall sit. Slide down until your thighs are parallel, and hold.

side_plank.name: Side Plank
side_plank.description: Balance on one forearm and the side of your feet with your body in a straight line.
side_plank.camera_setup: Face the camera lying on your side, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Lie on your side and lift onto your forearm, body in one line

faults.label: Hips dropping
faults.cue: Lift your hips — keep one long line from head to feet

correction_tips: Stack your shoulders over your elbow
Keep your body in one plane
side_plank.voice_intro: Side plank. Hips high, one long line.

sumo_squat.name: Sumo Squat
sumo_squat.description: With a wide stance and toes turned out, sit straight down between your heels.
sumo_squat.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Not deep enough
faults.cue: Sink deeper — sit straight down between your heels

faults.label: Knees caving in
faults.cue: Push your knees out over your toes

faults.label: Stance too narrow
faults.cue: Step your feet wider — well past shoulder width

correction_tips: Push your knees out over your toes
sumo_squat.voice_intro: Sumo squats. Wide stance, knees out, sit straight down.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.description: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with a soft bend in the elbows.
lateral_raise.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Arms not high enough
faults.cue: Raise your arms all the way to shoulder height
faults.cue_side: Lift your {side} arm a little higher — to shoulder height

faults.label: Raising too high
faults.cue: Stop at shoulder height — don't shrug the weights up
faults.cue_side: Your {side} arm is going too high — stop at shoulder height

faults.label: Arms too bent
faults.cue: Keep a long arm with just a soft bend in the elbows
faults.cue_side: Lengthen your {side} arm — just a soft bend in the elbow

correction_tips: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears
lateral_raise.voice_intro: Lateral raises. Lift out to shoulder height, nice and controlled.

front_raise.name: Front Raise
front_raise.description: Raise your arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower with control.
front_raise.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, upper body and hips in frame

faults.label: Not high enough
faults.cue: Lift to shoulder height, arms straight out in front

faults.label: Swinging
faults.cue: Keep your torso still — no swinging

faults.label: Arms too bent
faults.cue: Keep your arms long — just a soft bend in the elbows

correction_tips: Don't swing — stay still through the torso
front_raise.voice_intro: Front raises. Arms long, lift to shoulder height.

overhead_tricep_extension.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
overhead_tricep_extension.description: With upper arms beside your ears, lower the hands behind your head and extend back up.
overhead_tricep_extension.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, upper body and hips in frame

setup.cue: Raise your elbows overhead, upper arms beside your ears

faults.label: No lockout
faults.cue: Straighten your arms fully overhead

faults.label: Elbows drifting forward
faults.cue: Keep your upper arms vertical, elbows pointing up

correction_tips: Upper arms stay by your ears
overhead_tricep_extension.voice_intro: Overhead tricep extensions. Elbows point up, only your forearms move.

hip_hinge.name: Hip Hinge (Good Morning)
hip_hinge.description: With soft knees, push your hips back and tip your torso forward with a flat back, then stand tall.
hip_hinge.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Squatting instead of hinging
faults.cue: Keep a soft knee bend — push your hips back, don't squat

faults.label: Not hinging far enough
faults.cue: Hinge further — push your hips back until you feel your hamstrings

correction_tips: Push your hips back to a wall behind you
Stand tall and squeeze at the top
hip_hinge.voice_intro: Hip hinges. Push your hips back, flat back, soft knees.

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse Lunge
reverse_lunge.description: Step one foot back and lower until both knees reach about 90°, then drive back to standing.
reverse_lunge.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Not deep enough
faults.cue: Drop lower — let both knees bend to about 90°

faults.label: Leaning forward
faults.cue: Stay tall — keep your chest up and torso upright

reverse_lunge.voice_intro: Reverse lunges. Big step back, drop straight down, stay tall.

knee_push_up.name: Knee Push-Up
knee_push_up.description: From your knees, lower your chest toward the floor in a straight line from head to knees, then press up.
knee_push_up.camera_setup: Set the camera at floor level, side-on, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Kneel and walk your hands forward into a kneeling plank

faults.label: Hips bent
faults.cue: Keep a straight line from your head to your knees

faults.label: Shallow rep
faults.cue: Lower your chest further — bend your elbows to about 90°

correction_tips: Straight line from head to knees
knee_push_up.voice_intro: Knee push-ups. Straight line from head to knees.

side_lunge.name: Side Lunge
side_lunge.description: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
side_lunge.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Not deep enough
faults.cue: Sit deeper into the bending knee

faults.label: Straight leg bending
faults.cue: Keep your other leg long and straight

correction_tips: Sit back into the bending hip
side_lunge.voice_intro: Side lunges. Step wide, sit back, keep the other leg long.

bent_over_row.name: Bent-Over Row
bent_over_row.description: Hinged forward with a flat back, pull your elbows back past your ribs, then lower.
bent_over_row.camera_setup: Turn sideways to the camera, full body in frame

setup.cue: Hinge forward from the hips, back flat, torso at about 45°

faults.label: Standing up
faults.cue: Stay hinged forward — don't stand up as you row

faults.label: Short pull
faults.cue: Pull your elbow all the way back past your ribs

correction_tips: Hinge to about 45° with a flat back
Pull your elbows back past your ribs
Don't stand up as you pull
bent_over_row.voice_intro: Bent-over rows. Stay hinged, pull your elbows back.

sit_up.name: Sit-Up
sit_up.description: From lying with knees bent, curl your torso all the way up toward your knees, then lower with control.
sit_up.camera_setup: Set the camera at floor level, side-on, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Lie back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor

faults.label: Partial sit-up
faults.cue: Curl all the way up until your chest is close to your knees

correction_tips: Curl up one vertebra at a time
Keep your feet on the floor
sit_up.voice_intro: Sit-ups. Curl all the way up, and lower slowly.

leg_raise.name: Lying Leg Raise
leg_raise.description: Lying flat, lift straight legs toward vertical, then lower slowly without touching the floor.
leg_raise.camera_setup: Set the camera at floor level, side-on, whole body in frame

setup.cue: Lie flat on your back with legs straight

faults.label: Knees bending
faults.cue: Keep your legs straight as you lift

faults.label: Legs not high enough
faults.cue: Lift your legs higher — toward vertical

correction_tips: Press your lower back into the floor
leg_raise.voice_intro: Leg raises. Straight legs, lift toward the ceiling, lower slowly.
